headline: Underlying growth holds up once a one-time gain drops out
summary_short: Cencora's fiscal 2026 third quarter revenue rose 5.1% y/y to $84.8B and diluted EPS grew 11.9% y/y to $3.94, both up despite q/q comparisons being skewed by a one-time gain in the prior quarter.
summary_long: Revenue rose 5.1% y/y to $84.8B (+8.2% q/q) on broad-based growth in both segments — U.S. Healthcare Solutions +4.9%, International Healthcare Solutions +5.9%. GAAP gross profit rose 24.1% y/y to $3.61B and operating income rose 29.1% y/y to $1.12B, helped by the OneOncology acquisition and a $102.0M reduction of opioid liability, partly offset by higher acquisition-related opex. GAAP diluted EPS was $3.94 (+11.9% y/y); adjusted diluted EPS was $4.48 (+12.0% y/y). Q/q declines in EPS, operating income and net income reflect a $1.09B one-time OneOncology remeasurement gain booked in the prior quarter, not deterioration. Cencora repurchased $1B of shares, declared a $0.60/share dividend, and raised FY2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance to $17.75-$17.95 from $17.70-$17.90.

drivers.explanation: 4.9% revenue growth in U.S. Healthcare Solutions (specialty and GLP-1 product volume growth) and 5.9% growth in International Healthcare Solutions (European distribution and global specialty logistics growth).
Gross-profit growth in both segments plus a higher LIFO credit than a year ago, driven largely by the OneOncology acquisition's margin lift, partly offset by lower-margin GLP-1 sales mix.
Gross-profit growth outpaced a 21.9% rise in operating expenses tied to the OneOncology acquisition, aided by a $102.0M reduction of opioid liability from dismissed litigation.
